title: Fix incremental builds poisoning buildMode-specific artifacts (#2337)
summary: Fixed incremental builds in AL-Go that were corrupting buildMode-specific artifacts by re-publishing default build mode apps under incorrect artifact names, causing dependent projects to fail with runtime version mismatches.
key_points: DetermineBuildProject now receives buildMode parameter to download artifacts matching the current build mode dimension
Build-mode-prefixed artifact masks are used instead of build-mode-agnostic masks to select correct artifacts
Downloaded artifacts are extracted into build-mode-agnostic folders for later build steps, maintaining compatibility
Fixes propagating corruption in incremental builds where each run becomes the baseline for the next
Prevents AL1153 compiler errors from runtime version mismatches in multi-project repositories
